name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 57 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-09-22, at wavelengths from 0.86 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
